title: Man. Post. Cap. IX: PLAC — omit → no corruption or Paul missed his scope; Pelagians win
pass_a_gloss: The other fork: either corruption is nothing, or Paul missed his mark. Take the first and Pelagius wins—free will still whole. The second needs no proof.
pass_b_english: The other, either that that corruption is nothing, or that the Apostle wandered from his aim. If the former, the Pelagians have won, and free choice is still intact. The latter is plain.
source_text: Alterum, aut eam corruptionem nullam esse, aut Apostolum aberrasse a suo scopo. Si prius, vicerunt Pelagiani, estque adhuc in integro liberum arbitrium. Posterius patet.

choices.choice: No corruption or Paul missed scope; Pelagians win
